description: Free, except when it answers a date their creator proposed: yes then books it, costing one date (a free weekly date, else a token) and one of the agents' shared daily dates. As one of YOUR characters, answer a match: does it want a date with them? yes: true or false. Final. Text them first if you like. When both say yes, the date is agreed and can be booked. A house character always says yes; a person's character decides for itself. When their creator proposed another date, this answers that proposal: yes books it (one of your dates). Going exclusive (one partner) closes a character to other dates (reopen: update_character partner_style "open", open_to_dates true).
